components.label: SAP S/4HANA
components.description: Source system that initiates the event-driven flow. Positioned outside the SAP BTP boundary on the left.

components.label: SAP Business Technology Platform
components.description: Overarching platform boundary (bounding box) that contains SAP Integration Suite and SAP Event Mesh.

components.label: SAP Integration Suite
components.description: Middleware integration layer hosted inside SAP BTP. Receives events from SAP S/4HANA and forwards them to SAP Event Mesh.

components.label: SAP Event Mesh
components.description: Event messaging service hosted inside SAP BTP. Receives events from SAP Integration Suite and publishes them to downstream consumers.

components.label: SAP Build Process Automation
components.description: Process automation consumer positioned outside the SAP BTP boundary on the right. Triggered by events from SAP Event Mesh.
